literal: Excellence of tongue called possession of goodness, that goodness in any goodness included even is not.
translation: The possession of goodness called excellence of speech is a unique wealth. That goodness is not included in any other kind of goodness.
modern: நாவன்மை என்று சொல்லப்படும் நற்பண்பு ஒரு தனிப்பட்ட செல்வமாகும். அந்தச் செல்வம் வேறு எந்தச் செல்வங்களுக்குள்ளும் அடங்குவது அன்று.
explanation: The poet defines the power of speech as a unique and unparalleled wealth. By stating that the 'excellence of the tongue' (நாநலம்) is not included in any other kind of goodness, the couplet emphasizes its distinct nature. It implies that eloquence is an independent asset that cannot be replaced by other forms of wealth or virtue.
